summary: The robot freezes for 1 second in long corridors because pulseIn() lacks a timeout parameter, causing it to block code execution for its default 1-second duration whenever an echo signal isn't returned from a far-off wall.

causes.title: pulseIn() blocks execution for 1 second when no echo returns
causes.why: In long readCm(), the code executes `long us = pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH);` without specifying a custom timeout parameter.
causes.check: Point the ultrasonic sensor down an open hallway and observe if Serial output pauses for 1 second per sweep angle.
causes.fix: Pass a timeout parameter to limit the wait duration, such as `pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH, 30000);` which caps the timeout at ~30 ms.

rule_findings.title: pulseIn() has no timeout and can freeze loop() for 1 second
rule_findings.evidence: pulseIn(pin, level) waits up to 1,000,000 us when no echo returns (object out of range).
rule_findings.fix: Pass a timeout: pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH, 30000) caps the wait near 30 ms (about 5 m).
